name: Xi'an Triangle Aviation Co., Ltd.
summary: Xi'an Triangle Aviation Co., Ltd. engages in the research, production, sales and service of forging products in the aviation, aerospace, shipbuilding industries in China and internationally. The company offers engine blades, engine compressor journal, turbine shaft, turbine disc, rings, drum, and fan disc, as well as nozzle housing and aircraft landing gear. It also provides die and free forgings for aviation sector, including key structural parts and engine discs. The company was formerly known as Xi'an Triangle Defense Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Xi'an Triangle Aviation Co., Ltd. in September 2026. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Xi'an, China.
